packet.summary: A separate agent reviews Phase 4 against its rubric, re-checks each packet’s done-when condition and closes the gate boxes, with open items under Proposed.

body.p: After everything. Owns the gate boxes. A separate agent () runs the rubric and re-checks each "done when"; open items go under "Proposed". Done 2026-10-19 (): numbers at 77bc5d5 and 8d2aa06, fuzzing with a new XSLT target, the step budget judged fair, through function pointers, XSLT error locations and err:XTMM9000 fixed, sxml transform's relative references fixed, two helpers merged, xslt.h stable, the check; match="$var" membership and errors in included modules Proposed.
